review_candidates.description: Company Description Frame M.E.P is a multidisciplinary engineering services provider specializing in the supply, installation, and operation of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems. The company’s core services include HVAC and VRF/VRV systems, firefighting systems, plumbing and water supply, and electrical and control systems. Frame M.E.P also manages infrastructure works and is expanding into civil and architecture works, as well as maintenance services. This integrated approach allows the company to deliver comprehensive project solutions across various building and infrastructure sectors. Role Description The Tender and Procurement Engineer – MEP is a full-time, on-site role based in 6th of October. The role involves preparing tender documents, quantity take-offs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for MEP projects, in coordination with engineering and project teams. The engineer will review client specifications, obtain and evaluate vendor and subcontractor quotations, and ensure compliance with project requirements and company standards. Daily responsibilities include managing procurement activities, issuing purchase orders, tracking material deliveries, and maintaining accurate records of tenders and procurement documentation. The role also requires ongoing coordination with suppliers, negotiation of commercial terms, and support to project teams to ensure timely and cost-effective sourcing of materials and services. Qualifications Strong MEP engineering background with practical knowledge of HVAC, firefighting, plumbing, and electrical systems. Experience in tendering processes, including quantity surveying, cost estimation, and preparation of technical and commercial bids. Proficiency in procurement and supply chain activities, including vendor sourcing, quotation analysis, and negotiation. Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and contracts, with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation. Effective communication and coordination skills for working with internal teams, clients, and suppliers. Good command of relevant software tools (e.g., MS Office, Excel, and basic estimating or ERP systems); AutoCAD knowledge is an advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering field, or equivalent relevant experience. Organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tenders and procurement tasks under deadlines. Awareness of local market conditions, codes, and standards related to MEP works; prior experience in contracting companies is beneficial.

This is a fully remote role based in Egypt, working directly with our marketing and creative teams in Irvine, California. The role combines creativity, precision, and strategic thinking to communicate our message clearly and consistently to healthcare professionals and patients. The ideal candidate has a sharp eye for detail, a passion for clean design, the ability to translate complex medical and aesthetic concepts into elegant visuals, and the discipline to deliver independently across time zones. Ensure all materials digital, print, and environmental adhere to brand guidelines for tone, color, typography, and quality. Collaborate with marketing leadership to refine and strengthen the company’s visual presence. Design marketing materials such as brochures, flyers, social media graphics, trade show displays, product packaging, and sales collateral. Create digital assets for web, email campaigns, and presentations that reflect a high-end, medical-grade aesthetic. Support product photography, image retouching, and visual composition for promotional use. Prepare print-ready files and coordinate with vendors for production accuracy. Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to design engaging digital campaigns that drive brand awareness and lead generation. Design assets for social media, website updates, and paid digital advertising (Google, LinkedIn, Meta). Ensure all graphics are optimized for digital performance and accessibility. Work closely with internal teams including Product Design, Marketing, and Sales to ensure visual consistency across platforms.
